description: Two managers: the Python service (pyproject.toml and uv.lock, on the preset's release wait) and the Dockerfile's digest-pinned images.

packageRules.description: No release wait for the Dockerfile's images: GHCR publishes no release timestamps, so the wait would hold uv updates forever.
nimblebrain-server-sdk is NimbleBrain's own package, and a v0.x minor may break the API: a bump is a deliberate, reviewed change.
One PR a week for Python minors and patches; a major still waits for dashboard approval on its own.
